method: city composition applied; district surveys unavailable

baseComposition.sampleScope: Bangkok municipal solid waste (city level; not national). Sampling locations/number of samples not stated on the FY2565 table; previous years' tables report sampling at BMA's three disposal centres (On Nut, Nong Khaem, Sai Mai).
mappingRationale: plastic = recyclable + non-recyclable plastic + foam (expanded polystyrene is a plastic).

hazardous = 0.0: the BMA physical-composition table has NO hazardous category (household hazardous waste is collected and reported separately). 0.0 means 'not reported as a separate category', not a measured zero.
other = leather & rubber + textiles + stone & ceramics + bones & shells + disposable diapers (bones/shells treated as inert, not readily biodegradable).

zoneResearch.question: Does BMA publish waste composition by district group (กลุ่มเขต) or by district?
zoneResearch.answer: No (as of retrieval). BMA Environment Department composition pages (webportal.bangkok.go.th/environmentbma/page/sub/20995 and /28232) publish citywide tables for FY2563, FY2564 and FY2565 only; the FY2563 and FY2564 tables also give one column per disposal centre (On Nut, Nong Khaem, Sai Mai). No กลุ่มเขต breakdown and no district → disposal-centre assignment table was found on BMA pages, data.bangkok.go.th or by web search.
zoneResearch.consequence: Per-zone ('derived') composition is not possible; the citywide FY2565 composition is applied to each district ('estimated').

provenance.sourceName: องค์ประกอบมูลฝอยของกรุงเทพมหานคร (BMA Environment Department, Research & Development Group, Solid Waste and Sewage Management Office)
provenance.geographicScope: Bangkok citywide composition applied to district 1001 Phra Nakhon
provenance.methodology: City composition applied; district surveys unavailable. Every district receives the BMA citywide physical composition for fiscal year BE 2565 (2021-10-01 → 2022-09-30), mapped to the 6 app categories and rounded to 0.1 (largest remainder) exactly as in bangkok-composition.json.
limitations: Not a district measurement: identical shares in all 50 districts. Real composition differs by land use (markets, offices, housing).

BMA does not publish composition by district or by district group (กลุ่มเขต). It publishes composition by disposal centre (On Nut / Nong Khaem / Sai Mai) for FY2563 and FY2564 only; no official district → disposal-centre assignment was found (and assignments change, e.g. temporary diversions to On Nut), so per-centre values are NOT applied to districts.
Hazardous 0.0 = no hazardous category in the BMA table (household hazardous waste is reported separately); not a measured zero.
Composition is of collected waste sampled at BMA disposal facilities, not of waste generated at source.

Every district receives the BMA citywide physical composition for fiscal year BE 2565 (2021-10-01 → 2022-09-30), mapped to the 6 app categories and rounded to 0.1 (largest remainder) exactly as in bangkok-composition.json.
limitations: Not a district measurement: identical shares in all 50 districts. Real composition differs by land use (markets, offices, housing).

BMA does not publish composition by district or by district group (กลุ่มเขต). It publishes composition by disposal centre (On Nut / Nong Khaem / Sai Mai) for FY2563 and FY2564 only; no official district → disposal-centre assignment was found (and assignments change, e.g. temporary diversions to On Nut), so per-centre values are NOT applied to districts.
Hazardous 0.0 = no hazardous category in the BMA table (household hazardous waste is reported separately); not a measured zero.
Composition is of collected waste sampled at BMA disposal facilities, not of waste generated at source.
